sources.snippet: Bria Fibo 2.0 Edit Turbo image editing in a single network evaluation, no CFG — one LoRA adapter. Community implementation of Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM) (Liu et al., arXiv:2610.39633), compressing the 4-step distilled editing model to 1 step. Recipe: LoRA r=64 α=64 all-linear ×3 ...
